# Configuration Hierarchy & Session Initialization

Covers settings precedence, CLAUDE.md loading, skills/commands, and session startup behavior.

## Settings Precedence Hierarchy

Five-tier hierarchy from highest to lowest priority [5]:

| Priority | Scope | Location | Notes |
|----------|-------|----------|-------|
| 1 (highest) | Managed | Server, plist/registry, managed-settings.json | Cannot be overridden by any other tier |
| 2 | CLI arguments | Command-line flags | Session-scoped, temporary |
| 3 | Local | `.claude/settings.local.json` | Personal, gitignored automatically |
| 4 | Project | `.claude/settings.json` | Team-shared, committed to git |
| 5 (lowest) | User | `~/.claude/settings.json` | Personal, applies to all projects |

### Managed Settings Sub-Hierarchy

Within the managed tier [5][16]:
1. Server-managed settings (Anthropic servers)
2. MDM/OS-level policies (macOS plist, Windows registry)
3. File-based (managed-settings.json + managed-settings.d/*.json)
4. HKCU registry (Windows only)

Only one managed source is used — sources do not merge across tiers. Server-managed checked first, then endpoint-managed [16].

### Array Merging

Array-valued settings (like `permissions.allow`, `sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite`) are **concatenated and deduplicated** across scopes, not replaced [5].

## CLAUDE.md Loading

CLAUDE.md files load by walking UP the directory tree from cwd, checking each directory for `CLAUDE.md` and `CLAUDE.local.md` [8]:

| Scope | Location | Purpose |
|-------|----------|---------|
| Managed policy | `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/CLAUDE.md` (macOS), `/etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md` (Linux) | Org-wide, cannot be excluded |
| Project | `./CLAUDE.md` or `./.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Team-shared |
| User | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Personal across all projects |
| Local | `./CLAUDE.local.md` | Personal project-specific, gitignored |

All discovered files are **concatenated** into context, not overriding [8]. Within each directory, `CLAUDE.local.md` appended after `CLAUDE.md` [8]. Subdirectory CLAUDE.md files load on-demand when Claude reads files there [8].

### @path Import Syntax

CLAUDE.md files can import additional files using `@path/to/import` [8]. Relative paths resolve relative to the containing file. Max depth: 5 hops. Imported files expanded at launch [8].

### .claude/rules/ Directory

Modular instruction files for larger projects [8]:
- One topic per file (e.g., `testing.md`, `api-design.md`)
- Rules without `paths` frontmatter loaded at launch
- Path-scoped rules: YAML frontmatter with `paths` field, load only when Claude works with matching files [8]
- Supports symlinks for sharing across projects [8]
- User-level rules at `~/.claude/rules/` [8]

### claudeMdExcludes

Skip specific CLAUDE.md files by path or glob pattern [8]. Managed policy CLAUDE.md cannot be excluded [8].

## Auto Memory

Storage: `~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/` [8]. The `<project>` path derives from the git repository — all worktrees and subdirectories within the same repo share one directory [8].

- MEMORY.md: first 200 lines or 25KB loaded at startup [8]
- Topic files (debugging.md, etc.) NOT loaded at startup — read on demand [8]
- Requires v2.1.59+ [8]
- Toggle via `/memory` command or `autoMemoryEnabled` setting [8]
- Disable via `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1` [3]

## Skills System

Skills extend Claude's capabilities with SKILL.md files [13]:

| Location | Scope |
|----------|-------|
| `~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Personal, all projects |
| `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Project-specific |
| Plugin `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` | Where plugin enabled |

Key frontmatter fields [13]: `name`, `description`, `disable-model-invocation`, `allowed-tools`, `model`, `effort`, `context` (fork for subagent), `paths`, `hooks`.

Skill content lifecycle: enters conversation as single message, stays for rest of session. After compaction, re-attached with first 5,000 tokens each, 25,000 token combined budget [13].

## /init Command

Generates a starter CLAUDE.md by analyzing the codebase [14]. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT=1` for interactive multi-phase flow that asks which artifacts to set up (CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks) [8].

## Session Initialization Sequence

At startup, Claude Code [12][5][8]:
1. Loads managed settings (cached or fetched from server)
2. Applies CLI flags
3. Loads local/project/user settings
4. Loads CLAUDE.md files (walks directory tree)
5. Loads auto memory (MEMORY.md first 200 lines)
6. Loads system prompt, environment info
7. Loads MCP tool names (definitions deferred)
8. Loads skill descriptions
9. Fires SessionStart hooks
10. Ready for user input

See [lifecycle-hooks.md](lifecycle-hooks.md) for the complete 27-event inventory.

Server-managed settings fetch at startup, then poll hourly [16]. Cached settings apply immediately on subsequent launches [16].

## /status and /memory Commands

- `/status`: Shows active settings sources, configuration layer origins [5]
- `/memory`: Lists loaded CLAUDE.md files, toggles auto memory, opens memory folder [8]

## Gaps and Limitations

- Exact timing of SessionStart hooks relative to CLAUDE.md loading is not explicitly documented [1][8]
- Whether CLAUDE.md from `--add-dir` directories loads by default is configurable via `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1` [8]
- Skills vs commands distinction: both create `/slash-commands`, but skills support directories, frontmatter, supporting files [13]
- `CLAUDE.local.md` and the `@path` import syntax currently coexist as personal override mechanisms [8]
